summary: Senior Manager, Model Validation (Questbank) candidate with ~7 years across independent model review, validation, and risk governance at Moody's Analytics, EY, and Ortec Finance. Operates within a formal model-governance framework with delegated sign-off on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs, assessing conceptual soundness, data quality, and economic defensibility. Strong statistical modeling and Python foundation; applied familiarity with OSFI E-23, IFRS 9 credit risk / ECL. CFA charter plus dual MSc.
core_skills: Credit Risk & Expected Credit Loss (ECL) / IFRS 9

roles.title: Asst. Director - Modelling Services (Investment & Risk Lead)

sections.heading: Independent Validation & Model Governance
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios ($5-25bn per engagement, $50bn+ cumulative) - independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release.
Member of the model governance committee - contributing to methodology review, documentation and benchmarking standards, and model-performance assessment for client-delivered analytics.

Operate within a formal model-governance framework: review assumptions, assess conceptual soundness and economic defensibility, and escalate outputs lacking mathematical support - with documentation aligned to SR 11-7 and OSFI E-23 expectations.
Validate derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, ensuring consistency of sensitivities and scenario impacts at portfolio-level aggregates.

sections.heading: Data Quality, Stress Testing & Reporting
bullets: Review aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics, assessing data quality and suitability feeding downstream analytics.
Led design of a multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios, embedding behavioral assumptions and macro overlays.
Prepared validation reports and analytical summaries for senior stakeholders and clients' Heads of Risk, translating quantitative findings into decision-ready narratives.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating validation scaffolding, anomaly detection, and documentation - reducing cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe DB and PFaroe PM analytics platforms; validated model outputs post-deployment.
Served as technical liaison between client investment teams and product/development functions, translating requirements into structured development requests.

roles.title: Senior Consultant - IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 (credit risk / ECL) transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning regulatory requirements with model implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.
Advised actuarial, IT, finance, and program-management functions on IFRS 9 / IFRS 17 adoption; contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes.
Built and validated stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest-rate risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.
Performed asset-only and asset-liability portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition and robustness testing of allocation recommendations.
Led development and validation of the model capturing all Funding Policy dynamics for a three-plan university pension merger, evaluating duration, currency, inflation, and leverage strategies.
Presented model findings and risk analyses to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
